scope: Training-only probability allocation and source-cross-fitted calibration; exact factor bounds, known-behavior off-policy M2 correction; no new native continuation, validation fitting or PPO
behavior_weighting: Average seven separately importance-corrected component estimates within each case; uniform source then uniform eligible states. Common seeds remain paired, never IID traffic sources.
conditional_law: Uniform source, then uniform locked eligible cases within source
calibration_weighting: Target case mass times P/Q_generation divided by seven components and 64 draws; renormalize design mass after excluding the held-out source. Fixed shrinkage mass split equally across ten bins toward the training-only weighted global rate.
allocation_objective: Minimize sum P(a)^2 * estimated_Pr(CAV_first_collision|s,a) / Q(a) under q1>=0.1P1 and q2>=0.1P2; all later actions and natural partners remain conditional NDE
zero_objective: Return the natural distribution for an all-zero conditional objective
uncertainty: Training-side cross-fitted point diagnostics only; overlapping fitted folds and paired behavior samples are not IID replicates. No new-Q collision rates, naive confidence intervals or acceleration claims.
